mapper.select: SELECT p.posting_id, p.title, p.department, p.headcount, p.deadline, p.status, p.created_at, u.name AS created_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application a WHERE a.posting_id = p.posting_id) AS applicant_count FROM job_posting p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.created_by = u.user_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.*, u.name AS created_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application a WHERE a.posting_id = p.posting_id) AS applicant_count FROM job_posting p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.created_by = u.user_id WHERE p.posting_id = #{postingId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_posting (title, department, headcount, requirements, preferred, deadline, status, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{department}, #{headcount}, #{requirements}, #{preferred}, #{deadline}, 'OPEN', #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE job_posting SET status='CLOSED' WHERE posting_id=#{postingId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM interview_eval WHERE application_id IN (SELECT application_id FROM application WHERE posting_id = #{postingId})
DELETE FROM interview_schedule WHERE application_id IN (SELECT application_id FROM application WHERE posting_id = #{postingId})
DELETE FROM stage_history WHERE application_id IN (SELECT application_id FROM application WHERE posting_id = #{postingId})
mapper.update: UPDATE job_posting SET status='CLOSED' WHERE deadline < CURDATE() AND status='OPEN'
